thread:
sam_sales: Hey team — need quick deal desk run on a POC ask from Nimbus Health. They want a 3-month dedicated POC (reserved capacity) and are pushing for a bespoke discount to make it happen. Can we move fast on approval?

maria_ae: Context: Opportunity is warm, total platform TAM for them is ~250k ACV if they go prod. This POC is gating the exec buy-in. Security checklist is fine except they asked for data residency in eu-west and an SOC attestation.

sam_sales: They asked for 40% off list for the 3-month POC and then a potential 12-month commit if we pass evaluation. POC timeline = May 1 -> July 31.

tia_cust_success: POC scope: dedicated GPUs (2x A100 equivalent), low-latency routing, prefix KV caching enabled, support from solutions eng for first 2 weeks. We'll demo privacy / audit logs.

alex_infra: Quick FYI — dedicated capacity for 2x A100 for that window will be ~costly. If we reserve GPUs under Dedicated model we need a minimum billing profile; burst + setup adds ~10% infra ops.

jordan_dealdesk: Thanks — couple questions to triage: 1) Is the 40% across-hosted price or across a reserved rate? 2) What's the expected monthly token spend during POC (ballpark)? 3) Is Nimbus willing to sign a 12-month minimum commit post-POC? Discounts >30% need a VP-level sign-off unless there's strong strategic value.

sam_sales: Answering: 1) They're comparing to your hosted ratecard for generation/embeddings, asking for 40% off list. 2) Estimated tokens: ~150M tokens/month during active POC testing (spiky). 3) Customer said "likely yes" to 12-month if SLA/latency and data residency proven.

kevin_finance: Running quick margin calc. If 150M tokens/mo @ list and 40% off, estimated revenue over 3 months is low and hits below our baseline contribution margin given reserved infra. Need to see modeled unit economics. Can you drop the token estimate into the shared sheet?

sam_sales: Done — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-1769 (sheet tab "Nimbus POC econ").

jordan_dealdesk: Proposal from deal desk POV: we can offer an approved "POC concession" of up to 30% off list for 3 months if Nimbus agrees to: a) SOW sign + PO before kickoff, b) 12-month paid commit within 30 days after POC at a minimum ARR of $150k, c) limited SLA (best-effort) during POC but production SLA on full commit. Anything above 30% needs VP/Finance escalation with justification (reference, strategic value, competitive displacement). :eyes: 

maria_ae: Nimbus is pushing hard for 40% — they said a competitor (big cloud vendor) verbally promised 45% for a similar eval. We can probably secure the 12-month commit but need the 3-month hairpin discount to make the economics work for their buyer. They also want a short proof-of-value SOW and a single PO.

alex_infra: From infra side, if we keep this under "Dedicated (trial)" and don't fully reserve for longer than 3 months, ops can get creative with scheduling. But that increases risk of degradation during spikes. We should bake a capacity bump clause into SOW.

jordan_dealdesk: If you want >30% here's what we need in the request for VP sign-off: - explicit ACV upside (validated by AE) - referenceable logo value or strategic market positioning - finance endorsement that margin hit is acceptable - legal: standard MSA w/ limited liability redlines only - clear SOW w/ scope and rollback terms

kevin_finance: I'm OK to entertain 35% max for 3 months if they sign a 12-month commit at >= $180k ARR and pay the first month up-front. 40% only if there's clear strategic value (public reference + co-marketing + logo size) and legal accepts our liability limits.

sam_sales: Can we put a counter on the table to accelerate? Suggested commercial terms to propose to Nimbus:

```
Proposed commercial terms (internal):
- POC period: 3 months (May 1 - July 31)
- Dedicated trial config: 2x A100-equivalent nodes + prefix caching
- Discount during POC: 35% off list (conditional)
- Post-POC commit: 12 months minimum, $180k ARR (billed monthly)
- Payment: 1st month of commit paid up-front; POC costs are discounted but not fully free
- Conditions: SOW signed, PO received, SOC attestation + data residency clause (eu-west)
```

maria_ae: That looks reasonable. We can pitch 35% with the commitment and co-marketing ask. Nimbus told me they'd be open to reference participation.

jordan_dealdesk: I'll provisionally approve 35% for the POC pending: finance sign-off (kevin), legal sign-off on SOW/PO, and an exec note that this is a one-off concession tied to the 12-month commit. Please attach the SOW + redlines in this thread for tracking.

kevin_finance: Confirming — finance approves conditional 35% if the ARR >= $180k and PO upfront is in place. Also require an "accelerator" clause: if actual token consumption > forecast by 50% during POC, we reserve right to bill overage at list.

legal_bot: Legal input: will require standard MSA + SOW. Data residency carve-out needs exact storage/processing language. Liability cap stays at 1x fees for POC unless escalated.

sam_sales: Great — I'll update the customer with 35% conditional offer, attach SOW draft and ask for PO upfront. Will loop in legal for residency language. Sending now.

maria_ae: Quick note for tracking: tag this as deal/nimbus-health-17699 in SFDC and set deal stage to "POC - contracting".

jordan_dealdesk: Approved (provisional). Once I see PO + SOW + finance confirmation in thread, I'll stamp final and route to VP if needed. :white_check_mark: 

sam_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post the PO and SOW here as soon as Nimbus signs.

kevin_finance: Thx — keep me looped.

(assistant-bot): reminder: attach SOW to thread within 48h for deal desk audit.

sam_sales: Uploaded PO and signed SOW pdf to the thread (see link). Updating last message here with final docs for closure.

jordan_dealdesk: Final check — PO is good, SOW has residency language, finance greenlit. Approved 35% POC concession. Move to "contracting - legal sign off" and confirm once countersigned. :tada: 

sam_sales: Countersigned and sent to customer. Closing thread. :rocket:
